result.instructions: Call xax_capabilities first. Construct and edit with typed XAXEDIT1 record carriers. The server invokes pinned native XAX edit, verifies the staged candidate and only then publishes it. Build invokes native resolve/build. Execute requires --allow-execute and the native AppContainer/job launcher. Supported inputs are construction constants; results are u32 process exits. No shell, interpreter or JSON xax-construct-v1 decoder fallback.
